versions.changelog:
aistro 0.1.3

- Removed two test scripts: scripts/test-all.mjs and scripts/test-scenarios.mjs.
- No other user-facing changes.

aistro 0.1.2 — First public release with multi-mode astrology reports.

- Provides professional astrology consultation covering Q&A, personalized horoscopes, compatibility, and moon phases.
- Supports five modes: Chat, Natal Report, Predict Report, Synastry Report, and Moon Phase Report.
- Requires birth date, time, and place for detailed reports; supports casual chat with minimal data.
- Uses precise astronomical calculations via included scripts (with automatic dependency checks).
- Adds persona instructions for a mysterious yet comforting astrologer, with strict chat/guide mode separation.
- Ensures concise, interactive, and user-friendly report generation with summary-first, expandable details.
